verdict.rationale: Only community reports support this story: one user runs Ollama on an AMD RX 6650 via ROCm containers, and another notes native MLX on Apple silicon. A separate hands-on log shows ROCm detection failing and falling back to CPU, and there is no first-party documentation of vendor-specific GPU acceleration. missing for 10: first-party docs on GPU vendor support, any evidence of NVIDIA/CUDA acceleration, documented supported-hardware matrix, reliable AMD ROCm detection, independent benchmarks across vendors.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models on NVIDIA, AMD, or other GPU vendors using vendor-specific acceleration kernels

citations.quote: I have been running Ollama on my AMD RX 6650 for weeks. They have shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27.
native mlx should mean better memory handling on apple silicon
